utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m still a bit fuzzy on the full list, but I know they need volunteers and a few more supplies. I’ll check and let you know later.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Bo — just let me know what’s still missing when you check, and I’ll keep track of the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure thing — I’ll check and send over what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still checking the time, but I’ll keep asking around while I’m out. We could still use a few more volunteers and some supplies sorted for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira—please spread that we still need a few more volunteers and some supplies sorted for the repair drive. I’ll keep connecting folks who want to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely, I’ll keep spreading the word while I’m out and point anyone willing to help your way.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll swing by early and check what needs fixing first. If they already have a list, I’ll follow that and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — if you hear what they need most, please let me know. I’m still getting the updates second-hand, so I’d appreciate the heads-up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll go early, see what needs fixing most, and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and let you know who I connect with.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming. Please keep me posted on who you hear from so I can track it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do, Kira—I’ll keep you posted on who reaches out and what they can bring.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Opal — I’ll wait for the location. Just let me know when you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m checking the latest location now, and I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, thanks — I’ll keep an eye out for your update.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can spare some tools and a few hours on Saturday morning. I’d rather keep my name out of it for now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Uli — I’ll keep it quiet. What tools can you spare, and what time on Saturday should I plan for?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can bring a hammer, screwdriver set, and a drill. Morning works best — I can be there around 9.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Which spots need the most urgent help right now? I can take a look where it’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Rey — the most urgent spots are the homes with roof leaks and broken windows, plus a couple of front steps that need quick fixes. I’ll point you to the nearest one and let you know what tools to bring.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Rosa — point me to the nearest one and I’ll bring whatever tools you need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: They’re in good shape, and I’ll check the drill battery before I bring them over. If it’s low, I can top it up tonight.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps—if you can check the battery tonight, I’ll wait on the tools until we know the time and what supplies are still needed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—I’ll check it tonight and let you know if anything else is needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll jot down the biggest repair needs first, then we can match each one with volunteers and get the drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Rosa — let’s make that list and then we can match each repair with the right volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’ll start the list now and keep it organized as we go. If you have the top repairs in mind, send them over and I’ll match them to volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m checking the latest location now—right now it’s set up at Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — Maple Street is first, and I’ll send the next stops out as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ve got Maple Street noted as the first stop. Send the next locations when you have them, and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — let me know the timing and who’s bringing what, and I’ll keep an eye on the list so we don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll swing by early and check what needs fixing first. If there’s already a list, I’ll follow it and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds good — once you’ve checked, send me the list and I’ll help keep track of who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the details as soon as I have them, and I’d love to have you there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I’d like to stop by and help if I can. Send me the details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do — I’ll send the repair drive details as soon as I’ve got them, and I’m glad you’re coming by to help.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — I’ll wait for your message, and I just want to be sure I don’t miss any details.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep — Mara still needs a few volunteers, some tool donations, and help sorting the sign-up list. I’ll send the details once I have them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks — so it’s still definitely happening, right? I’ll keep an eye out for your details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. If you can confirm the time and list the supplies, I can help line up volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll check the time while I’m out and pass along that we still need hands, tools, and any spare supplies for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great — once you have the time, send it along and I’ll start lining up volunteers for hands, tools, and spare supplies.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect — send me the schedule, and I’ll follow it closely. I’m happy to help around pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll send the schedule soon and keep the window tight around pickup time. Thanks for making it easy to work around school.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, thanks, Faye. I’ll watch for the schedule and be ready right around pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll help sort the donations and load the last boxes. Where should I start?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Start with the donations by the porch, then we’ll load the last boxes together.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’m heading to the porch donations now and I’ll start sorting them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I’d appreciate the update. I’m happy to help once I know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: We’re short on duct tape, a Phillips screwdriver, and a few spare screws. If you can bring those, that’d cover the basics.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I can bring those by. Just let me know where to drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still short on paint, gloves, and a couple work lights—if you can bring those, we’ll be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can bring the paint, gloves, and a couple work lights.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Dane — that should get us set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Pia — send me the list when you can, and I’ll double-check the tally on my end. I’m happy to help keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sounds good — I’ll confirm the timing and who’s bringing what, then send you the list. I just want to keep everything simple and avoid any mix-ups.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks — I’ll watch for it and double-check the tally once it comes in. Keeping it simple is probably best.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and keep an eye on the donations. Send me the details, and I’ll help sort the sign-up list too if needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Mara — I’m still waiting on the exact location, but once Opal confirms it, I’ll send you the details right away.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great — just send it over when Opal confirms, and I’ll keep an eye out for donations in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Tess — I can spread the word and I’ll come by this Saturday to help sort donations and tools. What time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be wonderful, Sam — come by around 9 Saturday morning if that works for you. I’ll have the donations and tools ready!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds great, Tess — 9 works for me. I’ll see you Saturday and help get everything sorted.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How far along are we now, Oren? I just need the latest tally.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m still waiting on Pia’s list, so I don’t have the latest tally yet. Once she sends it, I’ll check and pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, just let me know as soon as you have it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning should still be fine on my end—I’ll double-check the school schedule and make sure it doesn’t conflict.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, thanks, Faye — I appreciate you checking. If it clears the school schedule, I’ll bring the drill and screwdrivers Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — I’ll confirm the school schedule and get back to you, and we’ll keep Saturday morning simple.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — send me the details and I’ll take a look at the sign-up list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — I’ll send the details over and we can get the sign-up list sorted. We still need a few volunteers and a couple of tool donations too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I can help sort the sign-up list, and I’ll look out for the details.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Uli — I’ll keep my ears open and won’t spread it around. If I hear anything useful about the repair drive, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. That means a lot—I’m still hoping to keep things quiet, but I can help on Saturday morning if that still works.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That still works, Uli — Saturday morning should be fine, and I’ll keep it between us. If I hear anything new about the repair drive, I’ll pass it along quietly.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
